newsitem.title: USA: Con Edison names Schoenblum treasurer.
newsitem.headline: Con Edison names Schoenblum treasurer.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc said Wednesday its board of trustees elected Hyman Schoenblum to the position of vice president and treasurer, effective March 1.
He succeeds John Cioffi, who is now Controller.

Schoenblum is currently director of the utility's financial restructuring team where he played a key role in preparing Con Ed's competitive opportunity filing with state regulators in October and in the talks with the public service commission since the plan's filing.

In his new assignment, Con Ed said, Schoenblum will be involved in the financial aspects of the utility's restructuring. He will also have overall responsibility for the company's financing, cash management, pension fund administration, risk management and real estate.
